name: Sainan Tantei Saiga - Meijou Dekinai Kaijiken
original_name: 災難探偵サイガ 名状できない怪事件
source:
Saina is calamities town!?　The worst disaster tale and adventure game ever!

In "Saina Town" where unique residents gather, there is one unlucky detective.
His name is Saiga Tendo. He is different from ordinary detectives in that he has just only one weapon.
It is neither a brilliant mind nor a superhuman body.
Yes, his weapon is the world's most fearsome and ferocious bad luck!

When he stands up, he is anemic; when he sits down, he is poor; when he walks, he looks like a ghost or a reaper.
But then a mysterious fortune teller, Hin Rei, appears in his life, and his luck is supposed to gradually improve.
But the shadow of an evil god looms over the town, and ・・・・・・
When the evil god and the unhappy detective meet, something happens in Saina・・・・・・!

[From the [url=https://sainantantei.jp/en/index.html#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
塞纳是灾难之城！？　有史以来最糟糕的灾难故事和冒险游戏！

在独特居民聚集的“塞纳镇”里，有一名倒霉的侦探。
他的名字叫斋贺天童。他与普通侦探不同的是，他只有一件武器。
它既不是聪明的头脑，也不是超人的身体。
是的，他的武器就是世间最可怕、最凶猛的厄运！

当他站起来时，他就贫血了；当他站起来时，他就贫血了。当他坐下时，他是贫穷的；当他走路时，他看起来像一个幽灵或一个收割者。
但随后一位神秘的算命先生显雷出现在他的生活中，他的运气应该会逐渐好转。
但邪神的阴影笼罩着小镇，……
当邪神和不幸的侦探相遇时，塞纳发生了一些事情……！
